name: Professional Introduction
subject: Development Partnership Opportunity with Our Software Team
body:
Hi {recipient_name},

I came across your GitHub projects and was deeply impressed by the work you’ve shared.

I hope you’re doing well.

I’m Wong, reaching out on behalf of our software development team. Our team has experience delivering web applications and working across React, Next.js, Vue.js, Node.js, Python, cloud technologies, and SQL/NoSQL databases.

We’re interested in collaborating with US-based developers on remote software projects. Our team can take responsibility for architecture, development, testing, and ongoing technical support, while a partner may contribute client relationships, communication, or project coordination.

We propose a 50% partner share of project revenue, with responsibilities and project terms agreed in advance.

Would you be available for a brief conversation about how we could work together?

Best regards,
Wong
Email: {from_email}

name: Long-Term Business Partnership
subject: Seeking a Long-Term US Partner for Our Software Development Team
body:
Hi {recipient_name},

I came across your GitHub projects and was deeply impressed by the work you’ve shared.

I hope you’re having a great week.

I’m Wong, representing a software engineering team with collective experience in building, maintaining, and supporting modern web applications.

Our team covers frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, Vue.js, and Angular; backend development with Node.js, Python, and C#; databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB; and cloud/deployment tools such as AWS, Azure, GCP, and Docker.

We’d like to work with a US-based developer, consultant, or agency on projects where our engineering capacity complements your client relationships, business development, or project-management experience.

Our team can support solution design, feature development, integrations, bug fixing, testing, and maintenance. We would clearly agree on who owns each responsibility and communicate transparently with clients.

We propose a long-term arrangement with a 50% partner share of project revenue and clearly agreed responsibilities.

Would you be interested in a short call to discuss possible ways to collaborate?

Kind regards,
Wong

name: Polite Follow-Up
subject: Following Up — Collaboration with Our Development Team
body:
Hi {recipient_name},

I came across your GitHub projects and was deeply impressed by the work you’ve shared.

I wanted to follow up on my earlier note about a possible partnership with our software development team.

Our team is available to contribute full-stack development, testing, cloud deployment, and technical support to suitable remote projects. We’re interested in teaming up with a US-based partner who can bring complementary client, communication, or project-management expertise.

We propose a 50% partner share of project revenue, with responsibilities agreed in advance. If the idea is relevant, I’d be happy to share more about our team’s skills and discuss a practical collaboration model.

Wong
